description: Try memory WITHOUT an account. Returns a temporary sandbox_key; pass it as the sandbox_key argument to remember, remember_batch, assemble_context, list_memories, update_memory or forget. Everything is deleted after 24 hours. Limits: 200 entries, 1 MB of text. No email needed. Do not store real personal data in a sandbox.
name: start_sandbox
title: Start a 24-hour memory sandbox
